description: A run of shots from a trip with friends in wild green hill country. A young man throws himself head first off a high concrete ledge and drops towards the dark water far below; a point-of-view shot from the ledge looks straight down at the white ring of foam where he hit the surface. Someone in an orange shorts and a blue jacket runs down a steep grassy slope in driving wind and mist towards a braided river below. At dusk three friends sit in a row on a narrow wooden plank bridge over a rushing white river, watching the moon over a mountain wall lit orange by the last sun. In the final shot four of them stand on a grassy ridge at sunset with their arms flung wide, one grinning into the camera as the sky burns orange behind them.
